issues.detail: The spoken Bas Udda arrival date and travel duration differ from the written chronology adopted by the user. Evidence: u1017–u1028 compress travel to a single overnight and explicitly name April 28. The written Session 19 note gives two full travel days and April 29 arrival. The original spoken wording is preserved.

resolution.reason: User explicitly chose the written April 29 arrival over the spoken April 28: "i think we should use the written date not the transcript date" and explained that April 28 should have remained a full travel day. User also set the opening evening to April 24 and confirmed the two-afternoons journey, giving April 30 departure and May 2 arrival.
